verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a hosted observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or deployment location. Tiered storage (elastic-docs-35) controls retention cost, not geographic residency, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
